description: Get a checklist run: per-check results with evidence, score, verdict and the change since the previous run. Poll after run_checklist every 30 to 60 seconds until `status` is terminal; `outcome` is the verdict on the experience. `comparison.changes` (what got better or worse) is usually the answer worth reporting. Pass a result's `result_id` to flag_check_verdict when the user says a verdict was wrong.

run_id.description: Checklist run UUID, from run_checklist or the recent_runs of get_checklist.

name: get_checklist_run

carry_over.description: Notes this run left for the next run of the same checklist by the same actor: the route that worked, blockers and workarounds, and the account state it left behind. Null when it left none or notes are switched off for the checklist.

summary.description: One line describing the diff, or null when nothing changed.

comparison.description: Diff against the previous completed run of this checklist. Null until this run completes, or when there is no earlier run.

outcome.description: Verdict on the experience once judged: 'passed', 'failed' or 'inconclusive'. Null while the run is in progress.

evidence.description: What the actor saw. For an informational check this is the observation itself.

result_id.description: Pass to flag_check_verdict to correct this verdict.

kind.description: 'false_positive' (recorded as passed, should have failed) or 'false_negative' (recorded as failed, should have passed).

label.description: The correction in words: 'Should have failed' or 'Should have passed'.

note.description: What the reviewer said was actually true.

verdict_correction.description: Set when a person has flagged this verdict as wrong. `status` is what the run recorded; this is what was true. Later runs of the checklist read it as calibration.

score.description: Weighted score (percent), or null when the checklist is not scored.

status.description: Whether the run itself finished: 'pending' or 'running' (keep polling), 'completed' or 'failed' (terminal).

summary.description: The actor's written summary of the run.

title: Get checklist run
